title: 第二章 乐郎君
slug: 盛唐风华全本免费-盛唐风华最新章节列表
content_zh:
还远不到枯水季节，桑干河河水比往年看起来都小了许多，露出大片的河床。孩童们正嘻嘻哈哈的在岸边翻拣着鱼虾。
两岸田地已经收割完了，麦穗都被捡拾得干干净净，黑色的田土上只有东一捆西一捆的麦秆。
河南岸高处，是一个不大的小村落，围有寨栅，设有碉楼——作为直面突厥的边地郡县，这种设施是乡间村落的标准配备。
徐乐就站在寨墙上，望着收割过后的田地做沉思状。
徐乐岁数，才从少年踏入青年不久，十足年龄十九。放在后世大概一七八一七九的身高，肩平腰窄，身形矫捷。
十九岁的他剑眉星目，线条柔和，笑起来嘴角上翘，竟然有边地少年难得的风流蕴藉的味道。这等人才放在长安洛阳，再有个世家子的身份，不知道会是多少仕女的深闺梦里人。
就是在神武县中，县城女孩子提起乐郎君，也总是嘴角含春眼波如醉。要是徐太公当年能让徐乐入鹰扬兵，或者破点钱买个吏职身份，只怕县中有官身的也愿意招这个上门女婿。而乡间女子提亲，徐太公又怕委屈了这个孙子，就这么一直耽搁了下来。
脚步声响动，一名身形健壮的青年正走上寨墙，对徐乐摇摇头。
徐乐皱皱眉毛：“韩约，怎样？”
韩约是徐太公当年带回来的从人之子，和徐乐一起长大，也跟着徐乐一起躲过徐太公的拘管在神武县中厮混，徐乐闯下乐郎君这个名号，也有韩约这个死党不少功劳。
韩约闻言之后摇摇头：“不妙，就算口粮减半，这租调也是交不起。”
韩约看着徐乐：“太公就还没点家底了？”
徐乐摇头：“几年都是突厥入寇，爷爷都停了回易，又不肯和官府交接，该交的租庸一文都少不了，这几年天时又不好，哪里还有家底？”
韩约握拳：“那就不交！遭灾了皇帝还开仓放粮呢，这王太守怎么还有脸搜刮？”
徐乐一笑：“你去和王太守说？这是出名的刚愎性子，在这马邑郡就是言出法随。你要上太守府闹去，我给你站脚助威。”
韩约愣头愣脑的挥拳：“咱们河东侠少怕谁来着？”
徐乐叹息一声，剑眉微蹙：“侠少也得有家有口啊，我倒是好办，躺在病床上的爷爷呢？这个岁数让他遭遇破家？徐家闾这么多乡亲呢？”
徐乐拍拍犹自不服气的韩约肩膀：“我也该把这责任扛起来了。”
韩约迟疑的看向徐乐，欲言又止。
徐乐笑道：“别做这个扭捏样，你这块头，看着让人发毛……我知道你意思，朋友这些天陆续上门来劝，让我入鹰扬兵，或者拜个门从个吏职。到时候什么都好说了。可你说我爷爷肯不肯？”

韩约摇头，躺在病床上的徐太公性子之硬，只怕不让这位灾年还拼命搜刮的王太守少许。徐乐不许入鹰扬兵，不许拜任何大小世家之门供其驱策。让这位乐郎君只能在乡里厮混。他都为徐乐感到可惜。
可那些朋友也只敢劝徐乐，没人敢对徐太公说的。徐太公可是当年一弓一马横扫桑干河河谷盗匪的人物！
这一代老一辈的人物还记得徐太公当年的模样——遗传给徐乐的好相貌，年岁不小还风度翩翩，骑在马背上身姿不输少年。落落寡合脾气古怪，但对身边人又绝对护短。动怒之际眉毛高剔，让人看着就心中生寒！
可现在徐太公也只是中风之后行动艰难的一个老人了。
韩约还是眼巴巴的看着徐乐，目光中似有祈求之意。
徐乐淡淡一笑，嘴角上翘，自有一种洒脱意味：“也只有继续走回易那条路了，不然就是破家，这王太守真能出兵剿灭。爷爷守护徐家闾那么久，现下也该我来了。”
韩约点头：“反正我随乐郎君去。”
徐乐点头：“也该服侍爷爷吃药了，你去操持上路物件人马，明早出发！”
徐家闾这小小村落之中，安安静静，看不到什么人影。正是收货季节，村中精壮多半都在田里场中忙碌。村中只有妇女，正在准备饭食，炊烟在村中各处袅袅升起，一副平静景象。
文人骚客，看到这山这水这小村，免不了要有稻花香里说丰年的诗性。但只有身在其中，看到零星村民脸上阴郁神情，才能明白在这乱世将至，直面突厥的边地，生活该有多么艰难！

content_en:
It's far from the dry season, and the water in the Sanggan River looks much smaller than in previous years, exposing a large area of ​​the river bed. The children were happily picking up fish and shrimps on the shore.
The fields on both sides of the bank have been harvested, and the wheat ears have been picked clean. There are only bundles of wheat straw here and there on the black soil.
High on the south bank of the river is a small village, surrounded by a stockade and equipped with watchtowers - as a border county directly facing the Turks, such facilities are standard equipment in rural villages.
Xu Le stood on the wall of the village, looking at the harvested fields in deep thought.
Xu Le's age has just entered youth from boyhood, and his total age is nineteen. In later generations, he was about 1,781,79 tall, with flat shoulders and narrow waist, and an agile figure.
At the age of nineteen, he has sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, soft lines, and the corners of his mouth turn up when he smiles, and he actually has a romantic and elegant flavor that is rare for a borderland boy. If such a talent is placed in Chang'an and Luoyang, and has the status of a son of aristocratic family, who knows how many ladies will be in the boudoir dream.
Even in Shenwu County, when girls in the county town mention Le Langjun, they always have spring in their mouths and eyes intoxicated. If Taigong Xu had allowed Xu Le to join Ying Yang Bing, or spent some money to buy an official position, I am afraid that people with official status in the county would also be willing to recruit this son-in-law. When a country woman proposed marriage, Taigong Xu was afraid of wronging his grandson, so he kept delaying it.
There was a sound of footsteps, and a strong young man was walking up to the wall of the village, shaking his head at Xu Le.
Xu Le frowned: "Han Yue, how are you?"
Han Yue was the son of a servant brought back by Taigong Xu. He grew up with Xu Le and followed Xu Le to escape from Taigong Xu's custody and hang out in Shenwu County. Xu Le gained the title of Lelangjun, and Han Yue also contributed a lot to his best friend.
After hearing this, Han Yue shook his head: "It's not good. Even if the rations are reduced by half, we still can't afford the rent."
Han Yue looked at Xu Le: "My grandpa, you haven't asked about your family fortune yet?"
Xu Le shook his head: "The Turks have invaded for several years. Grandpa has stopped returning transactions and refuses to hand over to the government. The rent that should be paid is not even a penny. The weather has been bad in the past few years. How can I still have family wealth?"
Han Yue clenched his fists: "Then I won't hand over it! The emperor still opened the warehouse to release grain after the disaster. How can this prefect Wang still have the nerve to plunder?"
Xu Le smiled and said, "You go and talk to Prefect Wang? He is famous for his headstrong temper. In Mayi County, he always obeys his words. If you want to go to the Prefect's Mansion to make trouble, I will stand up and support you."
Han Yue punched his head blankly: "Who are we Hedong heroes afraid of?"
Xu Le sighed and frowned slightly: "The young hero also has to have a family and a mouth. I can handle it easily. Where is the grandfather lying on the hospital bed? At this age, his family is ruined? What about so many folks in the Xu family?"
Xu Le patted the still unconvinced Han Yue on the shoulder: "It's time for me to shoulder this responsibility."
Han Yue looked at Xu Le hesitantly, but hesitated to speak.
Xu Le said with a smile: "Don't be so coquettish, you look so big, it makes people cringe... I know what you mean, my friends have been coming to my door one after another these days to persuade me to join the Ying Yang Army, or to be hired as an official. By then it will be easy to say anything. But do you think my grandpa is willing?"
Han Yue shook his head. Taigong Xu, who was lying on the hospital bed, was so stubborn that he was afraid that he would not let Taishou Wang, who was still searching desperately in the year of disaster, have any mercy. Xu Le was not allowed to enter Yingying and raise troops, and he was not allowed to worship any aristocratic family for his encouragement. Let this Lelangjun just hang out in the countryside. He felt sorry for Xu Le.
But those friends only dared to persuade Xu Le, and no one dared to tell Taigong Xu. Taigong Xu was the man who swept away the bandits in the Sanggan River Valley with a bow and a horse!
The older generation of this generation still remember how Taigong Xu looked back then - he inherited the good looks from Xu Le, he was still graceful despite his age, and his posture on horseback was not inferior to that of a teenager. He is lonely and has a weird temper, but he is absolutely protective of those around him. When you are angry, you raise your eyebrows, which makes people feel cold just by looking at them!
But now Xu Taigong only has a stroke.It's hard for an old man to move.
Han Yue still looked at Xu Le eagerly, his eyes seemed to be praying.
Xu Le smiled faintly, with the corners of his mouth turning up, giving him a sense of freedom and ease: "We have no choice but to continue walking back to Yi, otherwise the family will be destroyed. This prefect Wang can really send troops to wipe out. Grandpa has been guarding the Xu family for so long, and now it's my turn."
Han Yue nodded: "Anyway, I will go with Mr. Lelang."
Xu Le nodded: "It's time to serve grandpa and take medicine. You go and take care of the supplies and troops for the road. We'll set off tomorrow morning!"
In the small village of Xujialu, it was quiet and quiet, with no one visible. It is the harvest season, and most of the villagers are busy in the fields. There are only women in the village, preparing meals, and smoke rises from all over the village, creating a peaceful scene.
Literati and poets, when they see this mountain, this water, this small village, they will inevitably have the poetic quality of talking about a good harvest in the fragrance of rice flowers. But only by being there and seeing the gloomy expressions on the faces of scattered villagers can we understand how difficult life must be in these troubled times, facing the Turkic frontier!
